featured_reviews.name: Kajol Khot
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a great experience at Hayat Existence. The team provides valuable hands-on experience, allowing interns to conduct sessions and plan activities tailored to each client's needs. Yasmin Ma'am guided us through mock case histories and prepared us for challenges in client handling. Sara Ma'am conducted assessments and demonstrated both adult and child therapy sessions which was focus on their better understanding of their own behaviour. Afreen taught me the importance of patience, positivity, and adapting to each client's pace. Sayli helped me understand behavior modification and the value of active listening. Nazma Ma'am brought a positive and encouraging environment, and Rucha was very cooperative and supportive. Overall, it was a wonderful learning experience that enhanced my practical skills and confidence.

featured_reviews.name: Sana Sheikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience with therapy at Hayat, with Yasmin ma’am and with the team too, has been truly comforting and helpful. From the very beginning, I felt heard, understood, and accepted without any judgment. The sessions gave me a safe space to open up, reflect on myself, and slowly work through things I was struggling with. Yasmin ma’am has a very calm, empathetic, and grounding way of guiding conversations, which made it easier for me to gain clarity and perspective. Therapy here did not feel rushed or forced; it felt supportive and at my own pace. I genuinely feel more aware, emotionally lighter, and better equipped to handle my thoughts and feelings. I would wholeheartedly recommend Hayat to anyone who is looking for a safe, supportive, and compassionate space for their mental and emotional well-being. It truly feels like a place where you are met with understanding and care.
A special mention to Nazima ma’am for always greeting so warmly; her cheerful presence and welcoming smile genuinely made every visit feel lighter and more comforting.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Dr. Noorani is truly a gem of a person — one of the best in his field. His consulting charges are very affordable, yet for him, the patient always comes first. He is extremely calm, humble, and at times even poetic.

I still remember, once I visited his clinic without any prior appointment. The clinic was almost shut, and he himself was about to leave. But seeing me, he reopened the clinic. Later, I asked him, “Doctor, you could have simply asked me to come the next day. Why did you reopen the clinic just for me?”

His reply made me his lifelong admirer. With his poetic touch, he smiled and said:
‘Jab Uparwale ne mere jaane se pehle aapko bhej diya, to main kaun hota hoon rokne wala.’

That moment truly showed me his character and compassion.**
